findings.problem: The proof ends with an absorption argument: from `c ≤ s•d + k•c` with `k < 1`, derive `(1-k)•c ≤ s•d`, rescale by `(1-k)⁻¹`, and apply `CuntzBelow.of_le_smul`. The same steps appear in `cut_cuntzBelow_of_norm_sub_lt` (CuntzIdentities.lean, lines 183-192) and in `positive_cut_cuntzBelow_of_le_add_smul_one` (PositiveCutOrder.lean, lines 44-51). The Pureness tree copies them as well. Each copy repeats the `sub_smul`/`one_smul`/`sub_le_iff_le_add` rewrite, the `smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left` rescaling, the `inv_mul_cancel₀` simp and the `of_le_smul` call, with its own positivity side goals. The mathematical content of the three proofs is only the estimate for `c.1 ≤ s•d.1 + k•c.1`, and that content is buried under this boilerplate.
findings.proposed_change:
Add the following next to `CuntzBelow.of_le_smul` in TraceCone/CuntzIdentities.lean, so every user already has the imports and the NonUnitalCStarAlgebra hypotheses:

```lean
lemma CuntzBelow.of_le_smul_add_smul_self (c d : Positive A) (s k : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hk : k < 1) (h : c.1 ≤ s • d.1 + k • c.1) : CuntzBelow c d := by
  have hq : 0 < 1 - k := sub_pos.mpr hk
  have hsmall : (1 - k) • c.1 ≤ s • d.1 := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; exact sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr h
  have h2 := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hsmall (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
  exact CuntzBelow.of_le_smul c d ((1 - k)⁻¹ * s) (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hq.le) hs)
    (by simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq.ne', one_smul] using h2)
```

Proof sketch: move `k•c` to the left with `sub_smul`/`one_smul`/`sub_le_iff_le_add`. Multiply by `(1-k)⁻¹` and cancel the scalar. Finish with `of_le_smul`.

Use in the target: delete `q`, `hq`, `hsmall`, `hdom`. Keep `hc` and write
```lean
have hk : (2-β)*β < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos (show 0 < 1-β by linarith)]
exact (CuntzBelow.of_le_smul_add_smul_self c d (1+t) ((2-β)*β) (by linarith) hk hc).trans
  (hd.trans (starMul_cuntzBelow_abs y))
```

Use in `cut_cuntzBelow_of_norm_sub_lt`: keep `hcd : c.1 - d.1 ≤ k • c.1`. Derive `c.1 ≤ (1:ℝ) • d.1 + k • c.1` by `simpa only [one_smul, add_comm] using sub_le_iff_le_add.mp hcd`. Then call the lemma with `s = 1` and `.trans (conjugate_cuntzBelow b g)`. The `positive_cut_cuntzBelow_of_le_add_smul_one` rewrite is the same.
findings.benefit: The three proofs shrink by about 8 lines each. In the target, `abs_cut_cuntzBelow_of_norm_sub_lt` would then consist of the geometry (the `β` estimate, `starMul_add_le`, and the `c ≤ …` inequality) plus one call. A future change to the absorption step, or to the `of_le_smul` signature, would then be made once rather than in three or more places.
